author: adversarial-review fix (synced_reader shipped-feature audit): dedupe group WAV path literal
summary: Extracted app.domain.chunk_groups.group_wav_path(chapter_dir, group) -> Path as the single source of truth for a chunk group's canonical on-disk WAV path (chapter_dir / "segments" / f"{group['segments'][0]['id']}.wav"). Previously build_script_entry_for_group (chunk_groups.py) and TaskOrchestrator._emit_chapter_timing_sidecar (orchestrator.py) each re-derived this same path convention with an independent inline literal -- a silent-drift risk given the timing-sidecar hook's broad try/except swallows all exceptions. Both call sites now import and call the shared helper; no behavior change (verified byte-identical output + full existing test suites green).

changes.change: Added group_wav_path(chapter_dir: Path, group: dict) -> Path helper directly above build_script_entry_for_group. build_script_entry_for_group's seg_out = chapter_dir / "segments" / f"{first['id']}.wav" line replaced with seg_out = group_wav_path(chapter_dir, group).

_emit_chapter_timing_sidecar now imports group_wav_path from app.domain.chunk_groups (alongside its existing build_chunk_groups import) and its ordered_groups comprehension uses "wav_path": group_wav_path(chapter_dir, group) instead of the inline chapter_dir / "segments" / f"{group['segments'][0]['id']}.wav" literal.

invariants: group_wav_path is now the ONLY place the group-WAV naming convention (leader/first-member segment id names the file) is encoded; any future change to stitch naming must be made here and both call sites will follow automatically.
note: Added tests/domain/test_chunk_groups.py::test_group_wav_path_uses_leader_segment_id (direct unit test). Regression check: tests/domain/test_chunk_groups.py + tests/orchestration/test_timing_emission_on_finalize.py (10 passed), full tests/orchestration/ (558 passed), tests/api/test_api_generation.py (37 passed), full tests/domain/ (229 passed). ruff check clean on both touched files + the test file.
